concrete_changes.before: The isomorphism is not analogy. It is structural equivalence.
concrete_changes.after: I am proposing a comparison here. Establishing an isomorphism would require explicit states, transformations and preserved relationships; this essay has not supplied them.

concrete_changes.before: This is principal component analysis performed by hand, centuries before Pearson formalized the mathematics.

concrete_changes.after: Ba is the body brought to this reading: sleep, digestion and felt pressure may enter a person's account, but their timing alone would not establish a planetary cause.

concrete_changes.before: The Lorenz attractor has cycled through its lobes billions of years.
concrete_changes.after: The Lorenz model supplies a way to draw repeated motion between lobes.
concrete_changes.reason: Remove unsupported cosmic-history assignment to mathematical attractor.

concrete_changes.before: The work is not prediction. The work is recognition. Not ascension. Resolution. Not escape from the wheel. Sufficient clarity to inhabit the orbit you are already in.
concrete_changes.after: The chart and the screen can remain beside each other. The next useful step is to specify where their motions differ, as carefully as where they appear to meet.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated negation conclusion with the model-specific open task.

concrete_changes.before: Your Kundli has cycled through Dashas since the first human looked up and noticed Venus in the west. The isomorphism is not new. It has been waiting in the geometry, patient as La, for someone to hold the chart up to the screen and recognize the skeleton.
concrete_changes.after: The chart has its cycles; the screen draws motion between lobes. Holding them beside each other makes the comparison visible without proving an isomorphism.
concrete_changes.reason: Remove concluding identity claim that contradicted stated limits.
